name: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV
summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics NV, a biotechnology company, develops medicines focusing on oncology and immunology primarily in the United States and Europe. The company's pipeline products comprise GLPG3667, which is in a phase 2 clinical trial in dermatomyositis and systemic lupus erythematosus; GLPG5101, a CD19 CAR-T product candidate manufactured at point-of-care, currently in a phase 1/2 trial in relapsed/refractory non-hodgkin lymphoma; and GLPG5301, a BCMA CAR-T product candidate manufactured at point-of-care, currently in phase 1/2 in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.
